(Photo by Kevin Carter/Getty Images)

Two former senior FBI officials surrendered to federal authorities Friday to answer charges that they misled Congress about their work on the bureau’s Hunter Biden investigations.

Nicole “Nikki” Floris, 46, of Alexandria, Virginia, and Bradley Benavides, 56, of Aiken, South Carolina, each face a single count of making false statements to lawmakers, according to a criminal complaint filed Oct. 20 in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia. The pair once led the FBI’s Foreign Influence Task Force, a unit created to shield the 2020 election from foreign meddling that the bureau shut down in February 2025, Time.news reported.

Prosecutors say Benavides told House investigators he first learned about Hunter Biden’s laptop from a Wikipedia entry. He read it while preparing for his 2023 interview, according to the Justice Department. Internal records tell a different story. (RELATED: Hunter Biden Opens Up About Political Corruption, Insider Trading, And ‘Evil Incarnate’ Bibi Netanyahu)

The complaint cites emails showing he traded messages about the device with FBI colleagues in the weeks before the election. Floris denied that the task force ever discussed the president’s son, yet communications referenced in the filing place her in a year’s worth of exchanges on the topic.

Two former senior FBI officials, Nikki Cole Floris, 46, of Alexandria, Virginia, and Bradley Benavides, 56, of Aiken, South Carolina, surrendered today on arrest warrants issued after a criminal complaint charged them with lying to Congress about their involvement in the FBI’s investigations into Hunter Biden, announced @USAttyPirro. The charges stem from an ongoing investigation into the since-dissolved FBI Foreign Influence Task Force. Evidence shows that Floris discussed the FBI’s investigations into Hunter Biden routinely for more than a year both within the FITF and with others in the FBI. Contrary to his assertion that he learned of the Hunter Biden laptop from Wikipedia, Benavides regularly discussed the laptop with FBI officials in the leadup to the 2020 election. https://t.co/PqXXBuuZMa

U.S. Attorney Jeanine Pirro did not soften her language. “Lying to Congress by anyone strikes at the heart of our democratic system but when senior FBI agents lie to Congress believing they are above the law, it’s time to bring the hammer of justice down on them,” she said in the DOJ announcement.

This morning, two former senior FBI officials, Nikki Floris, 46, and Bradley Benavides, 56, surrendered on arrest warrants after being charged with lying to Congress about their roles on the Foreign Influence Task Force during the 2020 election. Floris and Benavides allegedly lied to Congress about their roles in the FBI’s Hunter Biden investigations, with one claiming they only learned about it from Wikipedia - despite evidence showing their involvement in helping shape the public narrative about Hunter Biden’s laptop right before the election. Lying to Congress by anyone strikes at the heart of our democratic system, but when senior FBI agents lie to Congress believing they are above the law, it’s time to bring the hammer of justice down on them. When senior officials entrusted with safeguarding our nation’s security choose deception over duty, they undermine the very institutions they swore to uphold. Today’s action makes clear that no one is above the law, and we will hold accountable all who obstruct the truth.

FBI Director Kash Patel added that one of the two had privately described “running a shadow government” during the 2020 race.

Two former senior FBI officials, Nikki Cole Floris and Bradley Benavides, were taken into custody today on charges of allegedly lying to Congress about their involvement in the FBI’s investigations into Hunter Biden. The charges stem from an ongoing investigation into the since-dissolved FBI Foreign Influence Task Force. Floris led the FITF as a Deputy Assistant Director from mid-2019 through mid-2022. Benavides was the FITF Section Chief from mid-2019 through the 2020 election. Both testified that the FITF was not involved in the Hunter Biden investigations. Documentary evidence, contemporaneous communications, and witness accounts contradict their testimony. Floris is also on record privately claiming to be “running a shadow government” during the 2020 election in her role on the FITF. Lying to Congress by senior FBI officials strikes at the heart of our system. No one is above the law. The FBI has already dismantled the corrupt CR-15 squad that engaged in political weaponization targeting their opponents, including President Trump. Thanks to @TheJusticeDept @FBIKansasCity and @USAttyPirro. -DKP🇺🇸

Floris’s attorneys rejected the case outright. “Nikki Floris is a patriot. She served our nation as a dedicated FBI intelligence officer for nearly 20 years. Yet today, the DOJ has accused her falsely of a crime on the say-so of politicians, not on the facts. It’s no coincidence the government is filing these nonsense charges now, years later, on the eve of an election,” they said in a statement to Fox News.

Both defendants appeared in Washington’s federal court after their surrender and requested a fast hearing to contest the allegations, the Associated Press reported.

The charges grow out of testimony the two gave to the House Judiciary Committee in 2023, when the panel reviewed the FBI’s handling of the Hunter Biden matter, the complaint states.

Republican Sens. Chuck Grassley and Ron Johnson had earlier accused the officials of using a 2020 briefing about Russian disinformation to weaken their own inquiry into the Biden family’s foreign business dealings, according to Fox News. The outlet also noted that the FBI confirmed the laptop was authentic during Hunter Biden’s 2024 federal gun trial.

دو مقام ارشد سابق اف‌بی‌آی روز جمعه تسلیم مقامات فدرال شدند تا به اتهاماتی مبنی بر گمراه کردن کنگره در مورد کارشان در مورد تحقیقات هانتر بایدن پاسخ دهند. نیکول «نیکی» فلوریس، 46 ساله، از الکساندریا، ویرجینیا، و بردلی بناوید، 56 ساله، از آیکن، کارولینای جنوبی، هر کدام با یک اتهام مجرمانه به شکایت متهمان مواجه شدند. ایالات متحده دادگاه منطقه ای برای ناحیه کلمبیا. Time.news گزارش داد که این زوج زمانی گروه ویژه نفوذ خارجی FBI را رهبری می کردند، واحدی که برای محافظت از انتخابات 2020 در برابر مداخلات خارجی ایجاد شد و این دفتر در فوریه 2025 تعطیل شد. دادستان ها می گویند که بناویدس به بازرسان مجلس گفت که او برای اولین بار در مورد لپ تاپ هانتر بایدن از یک ورودی ویکی پدیا مطلع شده است. به گفته وزارت دادگستری، او هنگام آماده شدن برای مصاحبه خود در سال 2023 آن را خواند. سوابق داخلی داستان متفاوتی را بیان می کند. (مرتبط: هانتر بایدن در مورد فساد سیاسی، تجارت خودی و بی بی نتانیاهو "تجسم شیطان" صحبت می کند)
این شکایت به ایمیل‌هایی اشاره می‌کند که نشان می‌دهد او در هفته‌های قبل از انتخابات پیام‌هایی درباره این دستگاه با همکاران FBI مبادله کرده است. فلوریس انکار کرد که کارگروه هرگز درباره پسر رئیس‌جمهور صحبت کرده است، با این حال ارتباطاتی که در پرونده ذکر شده است، او را در یک سال مبادلات در مورد این موضوع قرار می‌دهد. دو مقام ارشد سابق اف‌بی‌آی، نیکی کول فلوریس، 46 ساله، اهل الکساندریا، ویرجینیا، و بردلی بناویدس، 56 ساله، از آیکن، کارولینای جنوبی، امروز تسلیم شدند.

(Screenshot/YouTube/Tucker Carlson)

Third-party Wyoming gubernatorial candidate Rebecca Bextel told Tucker Carlson during an interview released Saturday that the Republican Party has “imploded” in the state.

Bextel, a former Republican committeewoman who is running under the Constitution Party to be the next governor of the Equality State, cited the late Charlie Kirk’s June 2020 warning during the interview that the state will become “blue” because Democrats will have infiltrated the Republican Party. She notably accused Republican gubernatorial nominee Eric Barlow of being an example of that. (RELATED: How The Left Is Taking Over America’s Reddest State)

Neither Bextel nor Barlow immediately responded to the Daily Caller News Foundation’s requests for comment.

“And so what happens is the Democrats, they really have no say in Wyoming politics, so they all switch over to the Republican Party. We always have conservatives that split the election for the primary and then we end up with the Democrat candidate,” Bextel said. “And that’s exactly what’s happening right now.”

Barlow beat President Donald Trump’s endorsed candidate, Megan Degenfelder, for the Republican gubernatorial nomination on Aug. 18.

“Our candidate for the Republican Party won’t even sign platform pledge to say that they’ll stick with the party 80% of the time,” Bextel continued. “This guy is so radical. He actually testified in front of Congress one time and said we needed to remove our dependence on fossil fuels in favor of a renewable energy model. So, can you imagine a guy like that being in charge of Wyoming, where our bread and butter is the mineral industry and the energy sector?”

Wyoming is the largest coal-producing state in the nation and also has more oil and natural gas producing leases on federal lands than any other state, according to the U.S. Energy Information Administration. As such, its four leading sources of revenue in 2026 included $12.4 billion from oil drilling and gas extraction, $4.1 billion from petroleum refining, $3.8 billion from gasoline and petroleum bulk stations, and $3.4 billion from coal mining, according to IBISWorld.

“Well … he’s funded by the Democrats — the dark, George Soros-funded money,” Bextel said when Carlson asked how a candidate like that gets the Republican nomination. “That has trickled its way into Wyoming. We’re a very cheap state to buy politically. So, you know, if you look at someone like Vivek Ramaswamy running a 100-million-dollar governor run, I’ll be lucky if I raise a million bucks. But that’s what I’m taking on.”

“He’s not a Republican,” she also said. “And so, I’m running to basically save us from turning into the state of Colorado. If I lose this election, we will be Colorado in four years.”

Trump won Wyoming 72.3% to 26.1% against former Vice President Kamala Harris during the 2024 presidential election.

“They just vote for the Republican because that’s who you vote for … they don’t know,” Carlson observed.

Bextel responded by telling him that that’s why she’s been “begging people, ‘Please don’t vote for the R.’”

“The Republican Party has imploded,” Bextel continued. “It’s not just imploded nationally, it’s imploded in Wyoming. We don’t have any leadership. People would prefer the values of the Republican Party, but there’s no litmus test, Tucker, to just put an ‘R’ by your name.”

Bextel resigned from being the Teton County Republican Party’s state committeewoman in May 2026. She previously ran for chair of the Wyoming Republican Party in 2025.

“We have tons of people, like in Teton County: a guy will run as a Democrat for county commissioner, lose. Run again as a Democrat, lose,” Bextel said. “Then go do something different, put an ‘R’ by his name, lose, and then join the board of the Teton County Republican Party. It doesn’t make any sense … We have to put the person above the party, and that’s what I’m asking everyone to do in Wyoming.”

(اسکرین شات/یوتیوب/تاکر کارلسون)
ربکا بکستل، نامزد حزب ثالث فرمانداری وایومینگ، طی مصاحبه‌ای که روز شنبه منتشر شد، به تاکر کارلسون گفت که حزب جمهوری‌خواه در این ایالت "فروخته" شده است. بکستل، یکی از اعضای کمیته سابق جمهوری خواه که تحت نظر حزب قانون اساسی برای فرمانداری بعدی ایالت برابری نامزد می شود، به هشدار چارلی کرک فقید در ژوئن 2020 در طول مصاحبه اشاره کرد که این ایالت "آبی" خواهد شد زیرا دموکرات ها در حزب جمهوری خواه نفوذ کرده اند. او به ویژه اریک بارلو نامزد فرمانداری جمهوری خواه را به عنوان نمونه ای از آن متهم کرد. (مرتبط: چپ چگونه سرخ‌ترین ایالت آمریکا را تصرف می‌کند)
نه بکستل و نه بارلو فوراً به درخواست‌های بنیاد دیلی کالر نیوز برای اظهارنظر پاسخ ندادند. بکستل گفت: "و بنابراین آنچه اتفاق می‌افتد دموکرات‌ها است، آنها واقعاً در سیاست وایومینگ حرفی ندارند، بنابراین همه آنها به حزب جمهوری‌خواه تغییر می‌کنند. ما همیشه محافظه‌کارانی داریم که انتخابات را برای انتخابات مقدماتی تقسیم می‌کنند و سپس به نامزد دموکرات می‌رسیم." "و این دقیقاً همان چیزی است که در حال حاضر اتفاق می افتد."
بارلو نامزد مورد تایید دونالد ترامپ، مگان دگنفلدر، را برای نامزدی فرمانداری جمهوری خواهان در 18 اوت شکست داد. بکستل ادامه داد: "نامزد ما برای حزب جمهوری خواه حتی قول پلت فرم را امضا نمی کند که بگوید در 80 درصد مواقع به حزب پایبند خواهد بود." «این مرد خیلی رادیکال است. او در واقع یک بار در مقابل کنگره شهادت داد و گفت که ما باید وابستگی خود را به فاس حذف کنیم

news.originalContent:
Nigerian police say a large group carried out the attack on Binnari village in Taraba State.

Gunmen have killed at least 10 people in an attack ⁠⁠on a village in eastern Nigeria, police said, as the country continues to battle banditry and armed groups in several parts of Nigeria.

Nigerian police said on Saturday that 10 bodies had been recovered as of Friday evening after a large group of gunmen on motorcycles attacked Binnari village in Taraba State.

According to police, the attackers also looted food from shops.

Survivors told the AFP news agency that at least 20 people were killed, while human rights group Amnesty International said in a statement on Saturday that the death toll was 40.

Amnesty International also said that while police ⁠had earlier confirmed the killing of 10 people, more bodies were recovered later on Saturday.

The gunmen opened fire just after Friday prayers, residents said.

“After the attackers left, we counted more than 20 bodies, and some people were still missing,” Binnari resident Sa’idu Nuhu told AFP.

Resident Isiyaku Musa also gave a death toll of at least 20.

Malam Abubakar Saifullahi, a community leader, told AFP that the attackers arrived on about 50 motorcycles, two men apiece, before raiding the village.

“They looted shops and took cash, foodstuffs and other provisions. They also took motorcycles abandoned by people fleeing the attack,” Saifullahi said.

Amnesty International criticised the Nigerian authorities, saying they “continue to leave rural communities in some parts of the north at the mercy of gunmen that are repeatedly committing atrocities with impunity”.

Banditry has become a growing issue in northwest and central Nigeria, with powerful gangs battling overstretched police and military across hard-to-reach, rural locations.

Taraba, a central-eastern state, also faces the non-ideological threat of “bandit” gangs.

Bandits raid villages, kidnap people for ransom, and levy “taxes” on farmers or miners in rural areas of Nigeria with little state presence.

Nigeria has also been fighting an armed rebellion since Boko Haram’s 2009 uprising.

Separately, on Saturday, the Nigerian military said it had killed 15 “terrorists” in northeastern Borno state in an air strike.
news.content: پلیس نیجریه می گوید که یک گروه بزرگ حمله به روستای بیناری در ایالت تارابا را انجام داده است. پلیس گفت، در حالی که این کشور به مبارزه با راهزنان و گروه های مسلح در چندین بخش از نیجریه ادامه می دهد، افراد مسلح حداقل 10 نفر را در حمله به روستایی در شرق نیجریه کشتند. پلیس نیجریه روز شنبه گفت که 10 جسد تا عصر جمعه پس از حمله گروه بزرگی از مردان مسلح سوار بر موتورسیکلت به روستای بیناری در ایالت تارابا، کشف شده است. به گفته پلیس، مهاجمان همچنین مواد غذایی مغازه ها را غارت کردند. بازماندگان به خبرگزاری فرانسه گفتند که حداقل 20 نفر کشته شدند، در حالی که عفو بین الملل در بیانیه روز شنبه اعلام کرد که 4 نفر کشته شدند. عفو بین‌الملل همچنین گفت که در حالی که پلیس قبلاً کشته شدن 10 نفر را تأیید کرده بود، اجساد بیشتری بعداً روز شنبه پیدا شد. ساکنان گفتند: «بعد از خروج مهاجمان، ما بیش از 20 جسد را شمارش کردیم و برخی از افراد همچنان مفقود بودند. حداقل 20 ملام ابوبکر سیف اللهی، یکی از رهبران محلی، به خبرگزاری فرانسه گفت که مهاجمان با حدود 50 موتورسیکلت، هر کدام دو مرد، قبل از یورش به روستا وارد شدند. سیف اللهی بین‌الملل گفت: «مقامات نیجریه گفت: «آنها مغازه‌ها را غارت کردند و پول نقد، مواد غذایی و سایر آذوقه‌ها را بردند.

news.originalContent:
From trans rights to Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, the party’s candidates have responded to voter shifts on a slew of issues.

Two years after United States voters delivered a stunning rebuke of the country’s Democratic Party by electing Republican President Donald Trump to a second nonconsecutive term, some of the party’s midterm candidates are reassessing stances on a host of hot-button issues.

Whether they have dialled it back on issues like transgender rights or ramped up efforts to oppose Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, Democrats in some of the toughest midterm battleground races are responding to voter concerns – or even breaking outright with party leadership.

Those shifts have resonated with some voters, while others have been alienated as the party tries to find its footing in Trump’s second term and wrestle away control of both houses of Congress from Republicans.

But in the time since Trump defeated former Vice President Kamala Harris in 2024, Democratic divisions have only grown deeper. Establishment and self-described moderates within the party have struggled to hold back a rising tide of progressive populism as voters increasingly demand stronger, bolder policies.

That movement, powered by groups like the Democratic Socialists of America, has forced a reckoning over what it means to be a Democrat in Trump’s second term, leading to significant differences among candidates on policies that often depend on where they are running.

Here’s how – and why – the party has shifted:

The most notable shift among Democrats has, arguably, been on Israel.

Three years after Israel launched its genocidal war in Gaza and killed more than 74,000 Palestinians following Hamas’s October 7, 2023, attacks, polls have suggested that Americans hold increasingly negative views on Israeli military actions.

A Pew Research Center survey conducted earlier this year suggested that 60 percent of US adults had an unfavourable opinion of Israel. That number is significantly higher – 80 percent – among US Democrats.

In response, some longtime Democratic supporters of Israel – including Senator Chris Coons, who is likely to chair the Senate Foreign Relations Committee if Democrats retake control of the Senate next month – have shifted, as voters, especially younger ones, demand greater accountability from the US ally.

The moderate Delaware Democrat told Politico in an interview this month that he wants a “thorough reexamination” of the US-Israeli relationship and is even willing to impose sanctions on Israel’s prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu.

It is a marked change in tone after Harris rejected calls to feature a Palestinian American speaker at the 2024 Democratic National Convention in Chicago.

Earlier this year, 40 Democratic senators voted in support of a motion that disapproved proposed military sales to Israel. Only seven Democratic senators voted with Republicans to block it.

But as a new Congress may include even more progressive voices demanding the US rethink its relationship with Israel, those calls would likely be met with stiff resistance from some in the Democratic leadership, including Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer.

The New York Democrat, who would likely become majority leader if Democrats retake the Senate, has said that the US “commitment to Israel’s security and defense must be ironclad”.

Following years of attacks from Republicans, Democrats in tightly contested US House or Senate races have downplayed – or outright dismissed – support for the transgender community, mostly when it comes to the participation of transgender students in school sports.

In Ohio, Democratic Representative Marcy Kaptur ran an advertisement featuring her saying, “Boys should not play in girls’ sports”. And in North Carolina, Representative Don Davis released a television commercial in which the Democrat says there “should always be a safe and fair space for women and girls in sports”.

Next door in South Carolina, Democratic Senate candidate Annie Andrews, a doctor, said in a newly released advertisement that she opposes “biological men playing in women’s sports”.

Trump’s return to the White House was fuelled, in part, by a now-famous advertisement in the 2024 campaign that highlighted Harris’s support for transgender Americans.

“Kamala is for they/them,” a narrator said in the advertisement, referring to gender neutral pronouns used by some in the transgender and nonbinary community. “President Trump is for you.”

But the reassessment of transgender rights after the commercial’s airing is not taking place in every part of the party.

On Thursday at a “Students vs Billionaires” town hall in Portland, Maine, Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez addressed concerns from a transgender college student who told the New York progressive that they felt “abandoned” by Democrats.

“They’re wrong”, Ocasio-Cortez said about some members of her party. “First and foremost, I want to just let you know how shameful and sorry I am that there are people out there that scare so easily after an election”.

The congresswoman added, “The moment you compromise the rights of a trans person in America, you compromise the rights of every citizen.”

During former US President Joe Biden’s term, Democrats encountered near-daily attacks from Republicans on the country’s immigration system.

US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) recorded more than 8 million encounters at the US-Mexico border between 2021 and 2025, fuelling concerns among some voters that the Biden administration had ignored the issue.

In Texas’s closely watched Senate race, candidate James Talarico has positioned himself as a “border security Democrat”, advocating for stronger border enforcement and comprehensive immigration reform.

Third Way, a US-based organisation that pushes for moderate policies, said stances like Talarico’s resonate better with voters because they have taken a proactive, rather than a reactionary approach.

“I remember very clearly when Harris came out and spoke at the DNC in 2024; she… said we need order at the border and to have a strong immigration system”, Third Way’s senior political adviser, Lucas Holtz, told Al Jazeera.

“The problem is, after that, the Harris campaign really did not stick with that line in the sand… They stopped taking a stand on these issues, and more voters thought that she was too far to the left.”

“[Talarico] is making the case in a lot of his ads that the Biden administration failed on securing the border… It’s putting Republicans on their back foot in some of these races.”

But among progressives, Trump’s response to the nation’s immigration issue has also prompted a strong swing to the left.

After several high-profile incidents earlier this year – including federal immigration agents in Minneapolis, Minnesota, shooting dead US citizens Renee Good and Alex Pretti  – calls to abolish, or drastically overhaul, US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) have gained momentum.

Left-leaning political groups and politicians have united behind a message of “abolish ICE”, which would dismantle the federal agency and end its enforcement authority.

As cost-of-living issues remain paramount for voters, Democrats of all stripes have coalesced behind the need for more government intervention in the country’s healthcare system.

But how exactly the party addresses rising medical costs remains up for debate.

Some progressives, including Michigan Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed, have championed policies like Medicare for All, which would expand the nation’s federal health insurance programme for seniors so all US citizens would be guaranteed healthcare.

Others running in more conservative states, like Andrews, have called for the return of Affordable Care Act subsidies that lapsed during Trump’s second term, as well as limits on health insurance companies’ profits.

Polling released by the independent health organisation KFF suggested that 66 percent of US adults now support Medicare for All, a 13-point increase from October 2020.

“Everybody’s going to have their own approach to this, but by and large, all Democrats want to move to a universal healthcare system in the best way possible”, Holtz said.

“We’re in agreement that we need to do better than what the Trump administration has done.”
news.content: از حقوق ترنس ها گرفته تا جنگ نسل کشی اسرائیل علیه غزه، نامزدهای این حزب در مورد مسائل متعددی به تغییر رأی دهندگان پاسخ داده اند. دو سال پس از آن که رأی دهندگان ایالات متحده با انتخاب رئیس جمهور جمهوریخواه دونالد ترامپ برای دومین دوره غیر متوالی، انتقادهای خیره کننده ای را علیه حزب دمکرات این کشور مطرح کردند، برخی از مسائل مهم این حزب در مورد کاندیداهای میان دوره ای میان دوره ای مورد توجه قرار گرفته است. خواه دموکرات‌ها در برخی از سخت‌ترین رقابت‌های میان‌دوره‌ای در میدان نبرد، به نگرانی‌های رای‌دهندگان پاسخ می‌دهند یا حتی به طور مستقیم از رهبری حزب جدا می‌شوند. این تغییرات در برخی از رای دهندگان طنین انداز شده است، در حالی که برخی دیگر با تلاش حزب برای یافتن جای خود در دور دوم ریاست جمهوری ترامپ و از بین بردن کنترل هر دو مجلس کنگره از دست جمهوری خواهان بیگانه شده اند. اما از زمانی که ترامپ در سال 2024 کامالا هریس معاون رئیس جمهور سابق را شکست داد، اختلافات دموکرات ها عمیق تر شده است. میانه روهای مستقر و خودخوانده در حزب تلاش کرده اند تا موج فزاینده پوپولیسم مترقی را مهار کنند، زیرا رای دهندگان به طور فزاینده ای خواستار سیاست های قوی تر و جسورانه تر هستند. این جنبش که توسط گروه هایی مانند سوسیالیست های دموکرات آمریکا قدرت می گیرد، وادار کرده است که معنای دموکرات بودن در دور دوم ریاست جمهوری ترامپ را بررسی کند، که منجر به اختلافات قابل توجهی در بین نامزدها شده است. در اینجا نحوه - و چرایی - صفحه آمده است

news.originalContent:
The pivotal run-off will determine whether Brazilians stick with their left-wing leader or shift towards the right.

Brazil’s presidential candidates Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Flavio Bolsonaro have rallied thousands of supporters in a final show of campaign strength in advance of the country’s closely contested run-off election.

Donning a red hat, Lula addressed hundreds of supporters at Rio de Janeiro’s Copacabana Beach on Saturday, waving a Brazilian flag from a campaign truck as crowds gathered on the final day of campaigning.

“The people must choose either someone who kisses the national flag or someone who kisses the American flag”, the 80-year-old told the crowd as he referenced his opponent’s ties to US President Donald Trump.

Lula is seeking a fourth, non-consecutive term in Sunday’s run-off, which will task Brazilians with determining whether to stick with their incumbent left-wing leader or join a broader regional shift towards the right.

Bolsonaro, a senator and son of former far-right President Jair Bolsonaro, secured 47 percent of the vote in the first round, narrowly ahead of Lula’s 45 percent.

Recent polling shows Lula and the younger Bolsonaro remain about even on the eve of the pivotal election.

A CNT/MDA survey released on Saturday revealed Bolsonaro would receive 46.3 percent of the vote compared ⁠with 45 percent for the left-wing ⁠Lula. Last week, ⁠the poll showed a slightly closer race with Bolsonaro leading ⁠Lula 46.8 percent to ⁠45.9 percent.

The poll’s margin of error was 2.2 ‌percentage ‌points.

On Saturday, Bolsonaro’s supporters, including hundreds of motorcyclists wearing Brazil’s yellow national football shirts, gathered in the southeastern state of Minas Gerais.

One of those supporters, Ebert Dorigo, accused Lula’s Workers’ Party (PT) of encouraging dependence on government welfare, arguing a change in direction was needed for the country.

“The values we uphold are nation and family. Our country is divided today because, due to welfare-based policies, some people … haven’t grasped that improvement and achievement come only through hard work,” he told the news agency AFP.

The bitter campaign has exposed deep divisions over economic policy, crime and Brazil’s political future, which Bolsonaro has pledged to tackle with hundreds of thousands of more spots in prison and cuts to government spending.

His father, who served as president from 2019 to 2022, is serving a 27-year prison sentence for attempting a coup after losing that year’s election to Lula.

The two candidates struck a calmer tone during their final debate on Friday, although they traded accusations over the country’s economic difficulties and their respective records.

For some voters, however, the choice has been a difficult one.

“If there were any other candidate, that would be a better option,” Gabriela Ribeiro Viana, an event organiser, told AFP. “But we’re stuck choosing between the worst, the horrible, and the lesser evil”.

news.originalContent:
Tehran warns that even limited strikes would trigger a response ‘several times greater’.

Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has blamed Washington for the unravelling of an interim deal aimed at ending the war with the United States and Israel, amid growing fears that the fighting could resume imminently.

In comments broadcast by Iranian Press TV on Saturday, But Pezeshkian also said that both sides should return to the deal and “conclude it”.

His remarks come amid growing fears that military action could resume as soon as this weekend, after US President Donald Trump said on Friday that he “may do another little Epic Fury”, using the codename of the US-Israeli war against Iran that started on February 28.

Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has warned that even limited strikes would trigger a response “several times greater”, according to comments reported by the semi-official Fars News Agency.

Iranian Armed Forces Chief of Staff Ali Abdollahi said on Saturday that the US military would not be allowed in the Gulf “under any circumstances and at any time”. Abdollahi said Trump could only “dream” of seeing US forces enter the Gulf, adding that he would take his dream to the grave.

Trump has suggested he could take further military action against Iran, while Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has said he remains committed to overthrowing the country’s government.

Both leaders face elections, with Israelis set to choose their next government on Tuesday. Meanwhile, Trump’s Republican Party faces crucial midterm elections on November 3, with Democrats potentially winning control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate. Such an outcome would be a major blow to Trump, who still has more than two years left in his final term in the White House.

Iranian government spokesperson Fatemeh Mohajerani said on Saturday that Tehran would not “wait for permission to defend itself”, adding that the country “seeks peace but will respond to any aggression with severe consequences”.

“Our position is clear: we do not flee from dialogue for peace, and we do not hesitate in defending the country. Those who harbour the illusion of destroying Iran must correct their calculations,” Mohajerani wrote in a memo.

Her comments came as Iranian judiciary chief Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei met Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei. The pair discussed how to tackle corruption and pursue compensation for Iranians affected by the US-Israeli war, among other issues.

Khamenei replaced his father as supreme leader after the latter was assassinated during the opening strikes of the war on February 28. He has not been seen in public since assuming the position in early March.

Parliament Speaker and chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf was reported to have met Khamenei earlier this week.
news.content: تهران هشدار می‌دهد که حتی حملات محدود، پاسخی «چند برابر بیشتر» را به همراه خواهد داشت. مسعود پزشکیان، رئیس‌جمهور ایران، واشنگتن را به دلیل افشای یک توافق موقت با هدف پایان دادن به جنگ با ایالات متحده و اسرائیل، در میان نگرانی‌های فزاینده مبنی بر از سرگیری قریب‌الوقوع جنگ، مقصر دانسته است. اظهارات وی در بحبوحه نگرانی فزاینده مبنی بر از سرگیری عملیات نظامی در پایان این هفته بیان می شود، پس از آن که دونالد ترامپ، رئیس جمهور ایالات متحده روز جمعه گفت که "ممکن است خشم حماسی کوچک دیگری انجام دهد"، با استفاده از نام رمز جنگ آمریکا و اسرائیل علیه ایران که در 28 فوریه آغاز شد. طبق اظهارات خبرگزاری نیمه رسمی فارس، سپاه پاسداران انقلاب اسلامی ایران هشدار داده است که حتی حملات محدود نیز پاسخی «چند برابر بیشتر» خواهد داشت. علی عبداللهی رئیس ستاد کل نیروهای مسلح ایران روز شنبه گفت که ارتش آمریکا «تحت هیچ شرایطی و در هر زمانی» اجازه ورود به خلیج فارس را نخواهد داشت. عبداللهی گفت که ترامپ فقط می‌تواند رویای ورود نیروهای آمریکایی به خلیج فارس را ببیند و افزود که رویای خود را به گور خواهد برد. ترامپ پیشنهاد کرده است که می‌تواند اقدام نظامی بیشتری علیه ایران انجام دهد، در حالی که بنیامین نتانیاهو، نخست‌وزیر اسرائیل گفته است که به سرنگونی دولت این کشور متعهد است.

news.originalContent:
هزاران نفر روز شنبه ۲۴ اکتبر، سه روز مانده به انتخابات پارلمانی اسرائیل، در تل‌آویو علیه دولت بنیامین نتانیاهو تظاهرات کردند. این انتخابات در حالی برگزار می‌شود که سه سال جنگ در غزه و درگیری‌های نظامی با لبنان و ایران، همراه با نگرانی از انزوای بین‌المللی و پیامدهای اقتصادی آن، به محورهای اصلی رقابت‌های سیاسی اسرائیل تبدیل شده‌اند.

به گزارش خبرگزاری فرانسه، رهبران چهار حزب اصلی مخالف دولت، از جمله گادی آیزنکوت، رئیس پیشین ستاد ارتش اسرائیل و مهم‌ترین رقیب انتخاباتی نتانیاهو، در تجمع روز شنبه شرکت کردند.

این تظاهرات را گروهی به نام «شورای اکتبر» سازمان‌دهی کرد که خانواده‌های قربانیان و گروگان‌های حمله هفتم اکتبر ۲۰۲۳ حماس آن را تشکیل داده‌اند.

این گروه خواستار تشکیل کمیسیون مستقل دولتی برای بررسی ناکامی‌های امنیتی منجر به حمله حماس و مشخص شدن مسئولیت مقام‌های اسرائیلی است.

شرکت‌کنندگان در این تجمع از میدان رابین به سمت میدان گروگان‌ها در تل‌آویو راهپیمایی کردند؛ مکانی که در سال‌های گذشته یکی از مراکز اصلی تجمع‌های اعتراضی علیه دولت نتانیاهو بوده است.

به گزارش رسانه‌های اسرائیلی، گادی آیزنکوت هنگام ورود به محل تجمع با استقبال گرم معترضان روبه‌رو شد.

هاداس فویراشتاین، یکی از شرکت‌کنندگان ۶۸ساله این تظاهرات، به خبرگزاری فرانسه گفت: «کسانی که در چهار سال گذشته ما را رهبری کرده‌اند، عملکرد بسیار بدی داشته‌اند.»

او افزود که اسرائیل هرگز در وضعیت کنونی خود نبوده است.

دولت نتانیاهو تاکنون با تشکیل کمیسیون مستقل دولتی برای بررسی ناکامی‌های امنیتی هفتم اکتبر مخالفت کرده و به‌جای آن پیشنهاد تشکیل کمیسیونی را داده است که نیمی از اعضای آن را ائتلاف حاکم و نیم دیگر را نمایندگان مخالف دولت تعیین کنند.

رهبران احزاب مخالف گفته‌اند که چنین کمیسیونی را تحریم خواهند کرد.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

انتخابات پارلمانی اسرائیل روز سه‌شنبه ۲۷ اکتبر برگزار می‌شود و تازه‌ترین نظرسنجی‌ها از رقابتی نزدیک میان اردوگاه حامی نتانیاهو و احزاب مخالف او حکایت دارند.

بر اساس نظرسنجی شبکه کان، رسانه عمومی اسرائیل، احزاب مخالف نتانیاهو ممکن است ۵۲ کرسی و ائتلاف حامی او ۵۰ کرسی از مجموع ۱۲۰ کرسی پارلمان را به دست آورند.

۱۸ کرسی باقی‌مانده نیز به احزابی تعلق می‌گیرد که در هیچ‌یک از این دو اردوگاه قرار ندارند؛ از جمله احزاب عرب.

از آنجا که تشکیل دولت در اسرائیل به حمایت دست‌کم ۶۱ نماینده نیاز دارد، نتایج این نظرسنجی نشان می‌دهد که هیچ‌یک از دو اردوگاه به‌تنهایی از اکثریت لازم برخوردار نیست.

تازه‌ترین نظرسنجی‌ها پیش از آغاز ممنوعیت انتشار نظرسنجی‌های انتخاباتی در شامگاه جمعه منتشر شدند.

یکی دیگر از موضوعاتی که در روزهای پایانی کارزار انتخاباتی اسرائیل به بحثی جنجالی تبدیل شده، نگرانی از انزوای اقتصادی آن کشور است.

بریتانیا و شماری از کشورهای دیگر در واکنش به افزایش حملات شهرک‌نشینان اسرائیلی به فلسطینی‌ها در کرانه باختری اشغالی و گسترش شهرک‌سازی، تحریم‌هایی را علیه کالاهای تولیدشده در شهرک‌های اسرائیلی وضع کرده‌اند.

بنیامین نتانیاهو روز جمعه گفت که اسرائیل ممکن است برای مقابله با پیامدهای انزوای بین‌المللی، به ایجاد سازوکارهای جایگزین در اقتصاد دیجیتال، از جمله استفاده از رمزارزها، نیاز داشته باشد.

او همچنین هشدار داد که بسته‌های تسلیحاتی چندمیلیارددلاری آمریکا برای اسرائیل ممکن است در آینده همچون گذشته ادامه پیدا نکنند.

این اظهارات با واکنش تند رهبران مخالف دولت روبه‌رو شد.

گادی آیزنکوت، رئیس پیشین ستاد ارتش اسرائیل و رقیب اصلی بنیامین نتانیاهو در انتخابات پیش رو، در شبکه ایکس با کنایه به پیشنهاد نخست‌وزیر از اصطلاح «بی‌بی‌کوین» استفاده کرد؛ ترکیبی از لقب شناخته‌شده نتانیاهو، «بی‌بی»، و واژه «کوین» به معنای سکه که در نام بسیاری از رمزارزها به کار می‌رود.

آیزنکوت نوشت که نتانیاهو در صورت پیروزی دوباره، اسرائیل را از اقتصاد جهانی جدا خواهد کرد و این وضعیت به خرید اینترنتی، سرمایه‌گذاری در صنایع پیشرفته و امنیت کشور آسیب خواهد زد.

او هشدار داد که نباید اجازه داد طرحی که آن را «بی‌بی‌کوین» نامیده، اقتصاد اسرائیل را نابود کند.

یائیر لاپید، نخست‌وزیر پیشین و رهبر کنونی مخالفان، نیز نتانیاهو را متهم کرد که چشم‌اندازی از کمبود کالا و مشکلات اقتصادی پیش روی شهروندان قرار می‌دهد.

لاپید در مصاحبه با شبکه ۱۲ اسرائیل گفت که ادامه نخست‌وزیری نتانیاهو ممکن است به تحریم‌های بیشتر، از دست رفتن توافق‌های امنیتی با آمریکا و آسیب شدید به اقتصاد اسرائیل منجر شود.

بانک مرکزی اسرائیل نیز اعلام کرد که رمزارزها راهکاری برای دور زدن تحریم‌های بین‌المللی نیستند و تأکید کرد که حفظ روابط اقتصادی با شرکای تجاری اصلی باید در اولویت قرار گیرد.

هزاران نفر روز شنبه ۲۴ اکتبر، سه روز مانده به انتخابات پارلمانی اسرائیل، در تل‌آویو علیه دولت بنیامین نتانیاهو تظاهرات کردند. این انتخابات در حالی برگزار می‌شود که سه سال جنگ در غزه و درگیری‌های نظامی با لبنان و ایران، همراه با نگرانی از انزوای بین‌المللی و پیامدهای اقتصادی آن، به محورهای اصلی رقابت‌های سیاسی اسرائیل تبدیل شده‌اند.

این تظاهرات را گروهی به نام «شورای اکتبر» سازمان‌دهی کرد که خانواده‌های قربانیان و گروگان‌های حمله هفتم اکتبر ۲۰۲۳ حماس آن را تشکیل داده‌اند.

این گروه خواستار تشکیل کمیسیون مستقل دولتی برای بررسی ناکامی‌های امنیتی منجر به حمله حماس و مشخص شدن مسئولیت مقام‌های اسرائیلی است.

به گزارش رسانه‌های اسرائیلی، گادی آیزنکوت هنگام ورود به محل تجمع با استقبال گرم معترضان روبه‌رو شد.

او افزود که اسرائیل هرگز در وضعیت کنونی خود نبوده است.

دولت نتانیاهو تاکنون با تشکیل کمیسیون مستقل دولتی برای بررسی ناکامی‌های امنیتی هفتم اکتبر مخالفت کرده و به‌جای آن پیشنهاد تشکیل کمیسیونی را داده است که نیمی از اعضای آن را ائتلاف حاکم و نیم دیگر را نمایندگان مخالف دولت تعیین کنند.

رهبران احزاب مخالف گفته‌اند که چنین کمیسیونی را تحریم خواهند کرد.

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

بر اساس نظرسنجی شبکه کان، رسانه عمومی اسرائیل، احزاب مخالف نتانیاهو ممکن است ۵۲ کرسی و ائتلاف حامی او ۵۰ کرسی از مجموع ۱۲۰ کرسی پارلمان را به دست آورند.

news.originalContent:
Houthi missiles reportedly struck a number of targets in Yemen, including Aden’s airport and a coastguard base.

Houthi fighters have launched a series of attacks on targets in Saudi Arabia and the seat of Yemen’s internationally recognised government in Aden.

In a Facebook post on Saturday, the Yemeni government’s Transport Ministry denounced what it described as the Houthis’ targeting of Aden International Airport with two ballistic missiles, calling it the “fourth such attack this month”.

The airport attacks pose “a threat to the safety of civil aviation” and have “humanitarian and economic repercussions for citizens” who rely on it, the ministry warned.

Yemeni authorities said that the coastguard headquarters and a second building were also hit.

The Houthis claimed attacks on the al-Nasr camp and Aden’s naval military base.

Yemen’s army said a Houthi missile killed three people when it malfunctioned and fell on a family home in Houthi-held Sanaa on Friday. The army said it was one of a number of missile malfunctions seen in recent weeks by the Iran-backed group.

Houthi-run Al-Masirah TV said on Saturday that Saudi coalition air strikes killed several civilians in Sanaa and in the port city of Hodeidah. The claim could not be verified and Riyadh has not commented on the alleged raids.

Also on Saturday, Saudi Arabia’s civil defence said on X that the Houthis had launched two ballistic missiles towards Mecca and Medina, warning of “the fall of shrapnel” following their interception.

Images shared on X by the Saudi Press Agency appeared to show a large, blackened missile-shaped object that had landed somewhere in Saudi Arabia.

Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi, Secretary-General of the Gulf Cooperation Council, described the Houthi attacks as “heinous”, which embody “a blatant disregard for the lives and security of civilians” in a statement shared on Saturday.

The Houthis said the claim that they targeted the two cities – the holiest in Islam – was a “huge lie”. They said their targets were three Saudi airports, oil infrastructure, and an airbase.

The Houthis have persistently targeted Saudi energy infrastructure and airports across the country with long-range strikes since a fragile ceasefire agreed in 2022 fell apart in July.

Intense fighting is continuing on Yemen’s front lines as the Houthis battle forces of the internationally recognised government for control of key areas.

On Saturday, Yemeni army spokesman Colonel Majed Abdullah al-Nazili said that government forces had carried out more than 700 “targeting operations” over the last 24 hours across Yemen, “neutralising” 300 Houthi fighters and disabling military vehicles.

Al Jazeera could not independently verify those figures.

Operations targeted field command centres, Houthi gatherings, weapons depots, and supply lines in Taiz, where intense clashes have been ongoing for days, the spokesman added.
news.content: بر اساس گزارش ها، موشک های حوثی به تعدادی از اهداف در یمن از جمله فرودگاه عدن و یک پایگاه گارد ساحلی اصابت کرد. جنگنده های حوثی مجموعه ای از حملات را به اهدافی در عربستان سعودی و مقر دولت شناخته شده بین المللی یمن در عدن انجام داده اند. وزارت حمل و نقل دولت یمن روز شنبه در یک پست فیس بوک آنچه را هدف قرار دادن فرودگاه بین‌المللی عدن توسط حوثی‌ها با دو موشک بالستیک توصیف کرد، محکوم کرد و آن را «چهارمین حمله از این نوع در ماه جاری» خواند. مقامات یمن گفتند که مقر گارد ساحلی و ساختمان دوم نیز مورد اصابت قرار گرفته است. حوثی ها مسئولیت حملات به اردوگاه النصر و پایگاه نظامی دریایی عدن را برعهده گرفتند. ارتش یمن گفت که موشک حوثی روز جمعه بر اثر خرابی سه نفر کشته و بر روی یک خانه خانوادگی در صنعا تحت کنترل حوثی ها سقوط کرد. ارتش گفت که این یکی از تعدادی از نقص های موشکی است که در هفته های اخیر توسط گروه مورد حمایت ایران مشاهده شده است. شبکه تلویزیونی المسیره وابسته به حوثی ها روز شنبه اعلام کرد که حملات هوایی ائتلاف سعودی چندین غیرنظامی را در صنعا و شهر بندری حدیده کشته است. این ادعا قابل تأیید نیست و ریاض در مورد حملات ادعایی اظهار نظری نکرده است. همچنین روز شنبه، دفاع مدنی عربستان سعودی در روز X گفت که حوثی‌ها دو موشک بالستیک به سمت مکه و مدینه پرتاب کرده‌اند و نسبت به "سقوط ترکش" در پی آن هشدار داده‌اند.

news.originalSummary:
Train slams into crane that collapsed onto railway line in Brazil

Video shows the moment a train collided with a crane that had fallen onto railway tracks in Brazil. After being struck by the train, the wreckage of the crane plunged into a street busy with traffic and pedestrians. The crane operator was injured in the incident in Sao Paulo.

(Photo by Alex Wong/Getty Images)

A college student waiting for President Donald Trump at a Florida campus rally answered a Fox correspondent’s question about his priorities with a rundown of economic pain before she steered the conversation to polling.

The correspondent was interviewing students on the campus ahead of the rally when she turned to a student named Andrew, according to the video. She asked what he expected the president to say and which issues mattered to him this election cycle.

Andrew said he wanted relief on the war, along with lower inflation, lower interest rates, and steadier prices for everyday shopping and fuel for his truck. “It’s just absurd pricing right now,” he said in the video. He added that he was hoping for improvement in the economy. (RELATED: Michigan Drivers Hit Hardest As Gas Prices Jump After Exxon Refinery Trouble)

The answer may not have been what the reporter expected as she quickly turned to the latest Fox News power rankings, which she said showed the local race moving further toward Republicans.

this answer about what issues matter to him from a college student waiting in line at the Trump rally wasn’t what the Fox correspondent expected to hear. She moved on with swiftness https://t.co/fXm8BHYEQZ

Trump headlined the midterm rally at Alico Arena on the Florida Gulf Coast University campus in Fort Myers on Friday, according to Fox News. He appeared for Republican gubernatorial candidate Byron Donalds and Republican Senate candidate Ashley Moody, 11 days ahead of the Nov. 3 elections. The campus sits in one of Florida’s most Republican areas, NBC News reported.

The student referenced the ongoing Iran conflict, which has driven up gas prices. Trump has called higher pump prices a small cost to keep Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon. He said prices would fall after the war.

Economic unease has become a liability for Republicans heading into the midterms, with Fox News polling pointing to a difficult path for the party, according to the outlet.

(Photo by Mark Wilson/Getty Images)

A U.S. government contractor was arrested Friday morning after he allegedly leaked classified information to a romantic partner.

The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) arrested District of Columbia resident Ian Brinksman, 42, for allegedly leaking national defense information to a woman he knew intended to publish classified information through her online Substack newsletter, the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) stated in a Friday press release. (RELATED: Pentagon Reportedly Escalates Hunt For Leakers By Ordering Polygraph Exams)

The DOJ did not immediately respond to the Daily Caller News Foundation’s request for comment.

🚨 U.S. Government Contractor Arrested for Allegedly Leaking National Defense Information “National defense information is classified to protect the American people from bad actors around the world who wish to do us harm,” said @AGToddBlanche. “The details alleged in this affidavit reflect the behavior of a government contractor who exempted himself from a federal law governing the protection of classified information. The Department of Justice will continue prosecuting individuals who leak classified information and put our national security at risk.” Read more: https://t.co/uTDo8tiSjA

“The FBI arrested the subject after he was caught allegedly betraying his oath and leaking classified defense information,” FBI Director Kash Patel states in the release. “Protecting America’s secrets is a top counterintelligence priority of this FBI - and anyone caught abusing their position of trust within the government by jeopardizing national security and putting our brave warriors at risk will be met with the full weight of justice.”

Central Intelligence Agency (CIA) Director John Ratcliffe also stated that the defendant provided services to the CIA as a contractor.

“The unauthorized release of classified material poses grave risks to our national security, intelligence sources, ongoing operations, and our officers,” Ratcliffe notes. “There is absolutely zero tolerance for leaking, and anyone who violates their oath will be held accountable and prosecuted to the fullest extent of the law.”

Brinksman worked for a U.S. government agency based in the Eastern District of Virginia beginning in 2020 before he started working as a government contractor for that same agency in 2022 as a developer for systems integration with a Top Secret security clearance, according to the criminal complaint.

At the time of writing, what appears to be Brinksman’s LinkedIn profile claimed he worked for the U.S. Department of State as a foreign service officer beginning in February 2020 before working for Deloitte as a senior strategy consultant in August 2022. It also claimed he has been an intelligence officer for the U.S. Navy since March 2020.

Brinksman, in November 2025, began dating a woman investigators believe is a journalist who started a Substack account focused on “Congress, War, and political economy.” Notably, she posted “I also accept leaks,” according to the affidavit. He allegedly contributed to five of her articles from March 11 through Oct. 5 containing Top Secret other highly classified information.

Brinksman, who authorities charged under the Espionage Act, could face up to ten years in prison if convicted.

news.originalContent:
در پی کشته‌شدن دو سرباز ارتش اسرائيل در شهر الخلیل در کرانه باختری اشغالی، اسرائیل عملیات امنیتی گسترده را در این شهر آغاز کرده و بنیامین نتانیاهو، نخست‌وزیر، از«یک غافلگیری بسیار بزرگ تشکیلات فلسطینی» صحبت کرده است.

این دو سرباز روز جمعه (اول آبان) با تیراندازی دو فلسطینی مجروح شدند و بعد بر اثر شدت جراحات، جان باختند. این دو فلسطینی نیز همان وقت به ضرب گلوله سربازان اسرائیل کشته شدند.

ارتش اسرائیل همچنین گفته است که این عملیات، منطقه‌ای از الخلیل را هدف قرار داده که دو مهاجم مسلح فلسطینی از آنجا آمده بودند و ممکن است چندین روز به طول انجامد.

بنیامین نتانیاهو، نخست‌وزیر اسرائیل، نیز وعده داد محله‌ای را که این مهاجمان از آنجا آمده بودند، ویران کند. او گفت: «گام اول شامل آواره کردن ساکنان، تفتیش خانه‌ها و نابودی زیرساخت‌های تروریستی خواهد بود.»

منابع محلی می‌گویند از روز گذشته دست‌کم ۲۵۰ خانواده به‌اجبار از خانه‌های خود در این شهر بیرون رانده شده‌اند.

خبرگزاری فرانسه گزارش داد که در محله «عین دیر بها» که میان دو تپه واقع شده است، روی ساختمان‌های تخلیه شده علامت ضربدر دیده می‌شود.

در این گزارش آمده که خیابان‌های این منطقه از مردم و خودروها تخلیه شده و تنها چند خودروی نظامی اسرائیلی در آنجا به چشم می‌خورد.

به برخی ساکنان و فروشندگان محلی دو ساعت فرصت داده شد تا محل زندگی و کسب خود را ترک کنند.

خالد دودین، فرماندار الخلیل، به خبرگزاری فرانسه گفت که حدود یک‌سوم این شهر هدف عملیات ارتش اسرائيل قرار گرفته است.

او گفت: «آن‌ها کار را از محله‌ای آغاز کردند که عاملان حمله از آنجا آمده بودند، اما هیچ تضمینی وجود ندارد که دامنه این عملیات گسترش نیابد.»

آقای دودین افزود: «این اقدام در حکم مجازات دسته‌جمعی غیرنظامیانی است که هیچ‌گونه ارتباطی با این ماجرا ندارند.»

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

بنیامین نتانیاهو اما می‌گوید که «اقدامات بزرگ‌تری» در راه است.

او در مصاحبه‌ای با شبکه آی۲۴ نیوز که شامگاه جمعه انجام شد، درباره تشکیلات فلسطینی گفت: «من برای خنثی کردن این تهدید، از روش‌هایی استفاده خواهم کرد که به نظرم بهتر است فعلاً جزئیات آن را فاش نکنم.»

نخست‌وزیر اسرائيل همچنین در پاسخ به این سوال که آیا با انحلال تشکیلات فلسطینی موافق است یا نه، گفت که در گذشته در برابر فشار سه رئیس‌جمهور آمریکا برای تلاش در جهت تشکیل یک کشور فلسطینی ایستادگی کرده است.

ایتامار بن‌گویر، مشاور امنیت ملی اسرائيل، که از چهره‌های راست افراطی این کشور محسوب می‌شود از دولت خواسته تا تشکیلات فلسطینی را منحل کند. محبوبیت او در نظرسنجی‌های پیش از انتخابات سه‌شنبه آتی رو به افزایش است.

این در حالی است که تا این لحظه، هیچ مدرکی برای دخالت تشکیلات فلسطینی در حمله الخلیل پیدا نشده است.

آقای نتانیاهو در این مصاحبه با اشاره به حملات اسرائيل به غزه، لبنان، سوریه و ایران گفت: «ما خاورمیانه را دگرگون کردیم. من گفته بودم که اوضاع را تغییر خواهیم داد و همین کار را هم کردیم.»

او افزود: «یک غافلگیری بسیار بزرگ هم برای تشکیلات فلسطینی در کار است.»

این در حالی است که ساعتی پس از انتشار اخبار این حادثه،‌ حماس از حمله به سربازان اسرائيلی استقبال کرد و از فلسطینیان خواست تا حملات بیشتری انجام دهند. با این حال حماس رسما مسئولیت این حمله را بر عهده نگرفت.

این حمله پس از افزایش تنش‌ها در کرانه باختری رخ داد. شهرک‌نشینان اسرائیلی، که از حمایت قوی متحدان راست افراطی نتانیاهو برخوردارند، تصرف زمین‌های فلسطینی و حملات به آنها را افزایش داده‌اند.

گروه حقوق بشری یش دین، ۶۷۲ مورد خشونت شهرک‌نشینان را در ۲۶ روز گذشته گزارش داده که تقریباً نیمی از آنها مربوط به برداشت زیتون است؛ یک رویداد فرهنگی سالانه برای فلسطینی‌ها که شهرک‌نشینان افراطی به دنبال توقف آن بوده‌اند.

تشکیلات فلسطینی، نهادی خودگردان است که بر اساس توافق‌های صلح دهه ۱۹۹۰، با همکاری اسرائیل بر بخش‌هایی از کرانه باختری حکومت می‌کند.

خبرگزاری فرانسه گزارش داد که در محله «عین دیر بها» که میان دو تپه واقع شده است، روی ساختمان‌های تخلیه شده علامت ضربدر دیده می‌شود.

در این گزارش آمده که خیابان‌های این منطقه از مردم و خودروها تخلیه شده و تنها چند خودروی نظامی اسرائیلی در آنجا به چشم می‌خورد.

به برخی ساکنان و فروشندگان محلی دو ساعت فرصت داده شد تا محل زندگی و کسب خود را ترک کنند.

خالد دودین، فرماندار الخلیل، به خبرگزاری فرانسه گفت که حدود یک‌سوم این شهر هدف عملیات ارتش اسرائيل قرار گرفته است.

او گفت: «آن‌ها کار را از محله‌ای آغاز کردند که عاملان حمله از آنجا آمده بودند، اما هیچ تضمینی وجود ندارد که دامنه این عملیات گسترش نیابد.»

آقای دودین افزود: «این اقدام در حکم مجازات دسته‌جمعی غیرنظامیانی است که هیچ‌گونه ارتباطی با این ماجرا ندارند.»

گزیده‌ای از مهم‌ترین خبرها، گزارش‌های میدانی و گفت‌وگوهای اختصاصی را هر هفته در ایمیل خود دریافت کنید.

بنیامین نتانیاهو اما می‌گوید که «اقدامات بزرگ‌تری» در راه است.

او در مصاحبه‌ای با شبکه آی۲۴ نیوز که شامگاه جمعه انجام شد، درباره تشکیلات فلسطینی گفت: «من برای خنثی کردن این تهدید، از روش‌هایی استفاده خواهم کرد که به نظرم بهتر است فعلاً جزئیات آن را فاش نکنم.»

نخست‌وزیر اسرائيل همچنین در پاسخ به این سوال که آیا با انحلال تشکیلات فلسطینی موافق است یا نه، گفت که در گذشته در برابر فشار سه رئیس‌جمهور آمریکا برای تلاش در جهت تشکیل یک کشور فلسطینی ایستادگی کرده است.

ایتامار بن‌گویر، مشاور امنیت ملی اسرائيل، که از چهره‌های راست افراطی این کشور محسوب می‌شود از دولت خواسته تا تشکیلات فلسطینی را منحل کند. محبوبیت او در نظرسنجی‌های پیش از انتخابات سه‌شنبه آتی رو به افزایش است.

این در حالی است که تا این لحظه، هیچ مدرکی برای دخالت تشکیلات فلسطینی در حمله الخلیل پیدا نشده است.

آقای نتانیاهو در این مصاحبه با اشاره به حملات اسرائيل به غزه، لبنان، سوریه و ایران گفت: «ما خاورمیانه را دگرگون کردیم. من گفته بودم که اوضاع را تغییر خواهیم داد و همین کار را هم کردیم.»

او افزود: «یک غافلگیری بسیار بزرگ هم برای تشکیلات فلسطینی در کار است.»

این در حالی است که ساعتی پس از انتشار اخبار این حادثه،‌ حماس از حمله به سربازان اسرائيلی استقبال کرد و از فلسطینیان خواست تا حملات بیشتری انجام دهند. با این حال حماس رسما مسئولیت این حمله را بر عهده نگرفت.

این حمله پس از افزایش تنش‌ها در کرانه باختری رخ داد. شهرک‌نشینان اسرائیلی، که از حمایت قوی متحدان راست افراطی نتانیاهو برخوردارند، تصرف زمین‌های فلسطینی و حملات به آنها را افزایش داده‌اند.

گروه حقوق بشری یش دین، ۶۷۲ مورد خشونت شهرک‌نشینان را در ۲۶ روز گذشته گزارش داده که تقریباً نیمی از آنها مربوط به برداشت زیتون است؛ یک رویداد فرهنگی سالانه برای فلسطینی‌ها که شهرک‌نشینان افراطی به دنبال توقف آن بوده‌اند.

تشکیلات فلسطینی، نهادی خودگردان است که بر اساس توافق‌های صلح دهه ۱۹۹۰، با همکاری اسرائیل بر بخش‌هایی از کرانه باختری حکومت می‌کند.

(Photo by JONNE RORIZ/AFP via Getty Images)

Attorneys and self-defense instructors told the Daily Caller News Foundation that firing a warning shot is almost a surefire way to face legal trouble, assuming one survives the incident.

In two recent incidents armed citizens fired warning shots, with one in Benton County, Washington, jailed on suspicion of murder for a few days while the police investigated until the prosecutor admitted the shooting was actually self-defense. In the second incident in Franklin County, Missouri, police filed no charges against the armed citizen, but experts warn that those who advise firing warning shots are missing the mark.

“Warning shots are generally forbidden for police and strongly recommended against for private citizens. There are often more earwitnesses than eyewitnesses, and they may interpret ‘Stop or I’ll shoot’ followed by a BANG as ‘He threatened to shoot someone, then carried out the threat,’” Second Amendment Foundation President Massad Ayoob, an expert witness and instructor in the use of force, told the DCNF. “The suspect in question may claim that the warning shot was a murder attempt and the shooter simply missed.” (RELATED: Blue State Prosecutor Admits Man Arrested For Murder Actually Acted In Self-Defense)

“Also, the bullet has to go somewhere,” Ayoob continued. “In one case, an officer in a city fired a warning shot upward to halt a felon running away from him, and the bullet struck and killed an innocent citizen on the top floor porch of a tenement building. To put the bullet somewhere safe, the shooter has to take his eyes off a potentially dangerous suspect. There are many downsides to firing warning shots.”

United States Concealed Carry Association (USCCA) principal training advisor Rob Chadwick agreed, warning that the use of warning shots could lead to trouble in court.

What feels like the safest choice in a moment of crisis often becomes the biggest trap in court. #warningshot #USLawShield #SelfDefense #LegalDefense #2A https://t.co/l1oZaW7UUv

“Firing a warning shot means discharging a deadly weapon without stopping the threat. Instructors teach that every round needs an identified target and a safe backstop,” Chadwick told the DCNF. “Laws on warning shots and self-defense vary by state, but in any jurisdiction a warning shot invites prosecutors to argue the shooter never faced the level of danger that justifies deadly force.”

Marc Victor, owner of Attorneys For Freedom Law Firm, said after trying “thousands” of cases, he viewed warning shots as “high risk” in the legal aftermath of a self-defense incident.

“Prosecutors like to use them really in a couple of different ways. First, if you’re firing a warning shot, lots of prosecutors will make the argument that because you had the ability to fire a warning shot the whole situation was not imminent,” Victor told the DCNF. “As imminency is a very important piece of building a self-defense case the prosecutor very commonly in these types of cases will say, because you had time to fire a warning shot, you were not at an imminent threat of death or serious physical injury. The reason I say it that way is because when you fire a warning shot you’re now in the category of deadly physical force.”

“You’re going to have to make the case that you are at an imminent risk of death or a very serious physical injury, and so they will use the warning shot as their evidence that the imminency card was missing, so that’s number one,” Victor continued. “The second thing that we see commonly on warning shots is a prosecutor will argue this was an escalation. You weren’t trying to use the least amount of force, what escalated the situation. So now you’re the aggressor, you’re not responding to the aggression.”

Even in a situation where nobody was struck by the bullet, Victor noted that prosecutors could still charge a gun owner who fired a warning shot in a self-defense situation.

“You are going to be responsible for where that round lands, and so it’s very common people get charged with unlawful discharge or endangerment because the prosecutor is going to make the case that you recklessly endangered other people by firing a shot up into the air,” Victor told the DCNF. “That round is going to come back down. You could even get charged with an aggravated assault. So another reason to discourage warning shots is because innocent bystanders sometimes get hit. You’re definitely going to be charged with a crime in that circumstance.”

Tom Grieve, an attorney affiliated with the United States Concealed Carry Association, noted that the warning shots could actually hand an edge to a criminal who assaulted an armed citizen.

“I want you to think of a defensive gun use as two deadly events unfolding at once: the kinetic encounter with your attacker and then the legal encounter that follows. Both the man in the mask demanding your property or your life and the justice system can ruin and take everything you have. That makes them both deadly force encounters,” Grieve told the DCNF. “Warning shots end attacks in the street but begin attacks against your future in court. Every case my firm has seen where someone contacted our office after using warning shots faced criminal charges after the bad guys fled. The reasoning? It’s a circular logic.” (RELATED: Bizarre Shovel Attack Over Porch-Peeing Dispute Ends With Gunshot)

“You are privileged to use deadly force, such as discharging a firearm, only if you are facing a deadly threat. The specifics vary from place and time, but that’s the short version. A prosecutor will ask: Was it really an imminent deadly threat if you could risk a warning shot instead of directly shooting the attacker?” Grieve continued. “If the warning shot fails to stop the attack, you may be dead. Alternatively, it was never a deadly threat to the point where deadly force was justified, meaning you jumped the shark, so enjoy these felony charges. Typical charges range from recklessly endangering safety, attempted homicide, to intentionally pointing a firearm.”

Grieve also cautioned that assailants would often try to claim they were the victim in the incident.

“By the way: every time the police interview the bad guys they 90% of the time claim that you attacked them. Remember, these assailants did not just wake up one day, decide to skip going to their W2 job and figure they will wing it [and] try some violent street felonies,” Grieve said. “It’s usually a long road to committing violent street felonies. They and their best friends have been arrested and in and out of the system for already many years. These bad guys know the system and they know how to play the cops. It does not always work out for them, but it does a frightening amount of the time because the good guys (that’s you, the victim) do not understand the system and what you are up against.”

Under current federal law, those convicted of an offense that can lead to more than one year in prison or those under indictment for such an offense are prohibited from possessing firearms.

وکلا و مربیان دفاع شخصی به بنیاد خبری دیلی کالر گفتند که شلیک گلوله اخطار تقریباً راهی مطمئن برای مواجهه با مشکلات قانونی است، با فرض اینکه فرد از حادثه جان سالم به در ببرد. در دو حادثه اخیر شهروندان مسلح تیرهای هشدار دهنده شلیک کردند، یکی در شهرستان بنتون، واشنگتن، به ظن قتل به مدت چند روز زندانی شد در حالی که پلیس در حال تحقیق بود تا اینکه دادستان اعتراف کرد که تیراندازی در واقع دفاع از خود بوده است. در حادثه دوم در شهرستان فرانکلین، میسوری، پلیس هیچ اتهامی علیه این شهروند مسلح ارائه نکرد، اما کارشناسان هشدار می دهند که کسانی که به شلیک گلوله های هشدار دهنده توصیه می کنند، هدف را از دست داده اند. مساد ایوب، رئیس بنیاد اصلاحیه دوم، یکی از کارشناسان استفاده از نیرو، گفت: "تیراندازی اخطار عموماً برای پلیس ممنوع است و شدیداً برای شهروندان خصوصی توصیه می شود. اغلب شاهدان گوش بیشتر از شاهدان عینی هستند و ممکن است "توقف کن یا شلیک خواهم کرد" و بعد از آن یک BANG را به عنوان "او تهدید به شلیک کردن به کسی کرد، سپس تهدید را انجام داد." "مظنون مورد نظر ممکن است ادعا کند که شلیک هشدار دهنده یک اقدام به قتل بوده و تیرانداز به سادگی از دست داده است." (مرتبط: دادستان ایالت آبی اعتراف کرد که مردی که به جرم قتل دستگیر شده در واقع برای دفاع از خود عمل کرده است)
ایوب ادامه داد: همچنین گلوله باید به جایی برود. در یک مورد، یک افسر در یک شهر برای جلوگیری از فرار یک جنایتکار یک تیر اخطار به سمت بالا شلیک کرد و گلوله به یک شهروند بیگناه اصابت کرد و کشته شد.

(Getty Images/Gent Shkullaku)

Military boards are disobeying Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s ban on openly transgender-identifying service members in the U.S. Armed Forces.

Nine of 12 Navy and Marine Corps review boards have recommended retaining transgender service members despite Pentagon directives calling for their discharge, according to The New York Times. The decisions raise questions about enforcement of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s military personnel policies and whether individual review boards are prioritizing their own ideology over the Pentagon’s stated readiness standards. (RELATED: Troy Jackson Backed Trans Prison Policy — Female Inmate Says Convicted Killer Threatened To Rape Her)

Directly after this executive order, the Pentagon enacted a system paying transgender service members to voluntarily separate from the military, the Times reported. As a result, hundreds left.

Those who challenged their dismissal faced three-member separation boards, according to the outlet. Those officers were given a set of criteria that a service member must meet to be dismissed. Boards of sailors and Marines have completely disregarded the criteria.

The Pentagon told the Daily Caller News Foundation that it does not comment on ongoing litigation.

“The Armed Forces have been afflicted with radical gender ideology to appease activists unconcerned with the requirements of military service like physical and mental health, selflessness, and unit cohesion,” President Donald Trump Stated in a January 2025 Executive Order. “[E]xpressing a false ‘gender identity’ divergent from an individual’s sex cannot satisfy the rigorous standards necessary for military service … adoption of a gender identity inconsistent with an individual’s sex conflicts with a soldier’s commitment to an honorable, truthful, and disciplined lifestyle, even in one’s personal life. A man’s assertion that he is a woman, and his requirement that others honor this falsehood, is not consistent with the humility and selflessness required of a service member.”

The U.S. Military is gender neutral and merit based. If you need to identify as anything other than male or female which is what the paperwork across the nation usually has in its infrastructure, then you disqualify yourself. Many were also joining the military to get their transgender surgeries and treatments paid for by the federal government. The military should not be the personal elective treatment facility for anyone. That was a waste of the military’s time and money. If you want surgery, stay out of the military and pay for it yourself like you should.

Marine Staff Sgt. Damien Contreras, a biological female, was put on paid leave in April due to a 2017 sex change hormone usage and her choice to identify as a male, according to the Times. In August, she was flown from Hawaii to Marine Corps Base Quantico to face a separation board. At the hearing, a government lawyer presented documents proving her struggles with gender identity. Rather than circle “a history of cross sex hormone therapy,” automatic grounds for separation, they circled “remains qualified.”

The Navy has nearly twice as many people who identify as gay, bisexual or transgender compared to other branches which indicated potential ideological bias, the Times reported.
news.content:
(Getty Images/Gent Shkullaku)
هیئت‌های نظامی از ممنوعیت وزیر دفاع پیت هگزث در مورد اعضای خدماتی که آشکارا دارای هویت تراجنسیتی هستند در نیروهای مسلح ایالات متحده اطاعت نمی‌کنند. به گزارش نیویورک‌تایمز، 9 هیئت از 12 هیئت بازبینی نیروی دریایی و تفنگداران دریایی، علی‌رغم دستورالعمل‌های پنتاگون که خواستار اخراج آن‌ها شده است، توصیه کرده‌اند که اعضای خدمات تراجنسیتی را حفظ کنند. این تصمیم‌ها سوالاتی را در مورد اجرای سیاست‌های پرسنل نظامی وزیر دفاع پیت هگزث و اینکه آیا هیئت‌های بازنگری فردی ایدئولوژی خود را بر استانداردهای آمادگی اعلام شده پنتاگون ترجیح می‌دهند، ایجاد می‌کند. (مرتبط: حمایت تروی جکسون از سیاست زندان ترنس - زن زندانی می گوید قاتل محکوم به تجاوز به او تهدید می کند) به گزارش تایمز، بلافاصله پس از این فرمان اجرایی، پنتاگون سیستمی را وضع کرد که به اعضای خدمات تراجنسیتی پول پرداخت می کرد تا داوطلبانه از ارتش جدا شوند. در نتیجه، صدها نفر ترک کردند. به گفته این رسانه، کسانی که اخراج خود را به چالش کشیدند، با هیئت های سه نفره جدایی روبرو شدند. به آن افسران مجموعه‌ای از معیارها داده شد که یک سرباز برای اخراج باید آنها را داشته باشد. هیئت ملوانان و تفنگداران دریایی این معیارها را کاملاً نادیده گرفته اند. پنتاگون به بنیاد خبری دیلی کالر گفت که در مورد دعاوی جاری اظهار نظری نمی کند.

(Photo by WANG Zhao / AFP via Getty Images

A rising San Francisco human resources startup’s use of a blacklisted Chinese AI lab’s model is setting off alarm bells as Beijing continues to reel in American companies.

Rippling touts itself as a one-stop-shop AI platform for human resources, information technology and finance that services over 20,000 U.S. companies, per its website. The model’s maker, Z.ai, also known as Zhipu, had already made it on to a U.S. government entity list months earlier over its ties to the Chinese military.

“Any data that transits an API through servers based in China is at risk of deliberate data exfiltration and intelligence collection. This is the same problem we’ve had with TikTok, but scaled up to be 100 times worse as people are uploading sensitive personal information. They’re not making fun videos of kids dancing, but asking for pretty sensitive advice about every aspect of their lives as they’re using AI systems,” Ryan Fedusiak, a fellow at the American Enterprise Institute (AEI) who focuses on China and AI-related issues, told the Daily Caller News Foundation.

Open models “can be tampered with in ways that are very difficult to detect, and we haven’t seen a huge number of attacks like this yet. But I do worry that the potential is certainly there,” Fedusiak warned.

Rippling is not the only company to take Chinese AI for a test drive. Giants like DoorDash and small startups are increasingly adopting Chinese AI models because they provide nearly-frontier level performance at far less cost than Anthropic and OpenAI, Fortune reported. Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky said in 2025 the company used Alibaba’s Qwen AI model, referring to it as “fast and cheap,” per NPR.

Rippling did not respond to a request for comment from the DCNF about the extent to which the company uses Chinese AI models and how it protects its clients’ data. Zhipu also did not respond.

Rippling CEO Parker Conrad in July on X credited Zhipu’s GLM 5.2 model, or Z.ai’s frontier open-source model, after the company found the model performed nearly as well as frontier, closed AI models at substantially less cost.

“This is why access to open weights matters - GLM 5.2 is 85% cheaper but nearly identical performance,” he wrote.

The AI human resources startup mainly uses OpenAI and Anthropic as its primary AI models, an AI usage guide published on the company’s website shows. The company bars its AI service providers from storing and using client data to train AI models.

This is why access to open weights matters - GLM 5.2 is 85% cheaper but nearly identical performance. Really impressive to see how well Grok 4.5 perform here, on a set of benchmarks that labs are not training against.

Rippling President Matt MacInnis published test results in the same month showing that the company used the controversial Z.ai GLM model as part of its July testing.

“The benchmark covers 15 model variants and is built around real-world business agent tasks using real-world company data and workflows. Across pass rates, latency, and actual dollar cost, the open-weight models were surprisingly competitive,” MacInnis wrote. “GLM in particular seems to offer a shortcut to cost reduction versus the models from the “labs.” Grok also surprised to the upside on performance and cost.”

The company’s chief technology officer (CTO), Albert Strasheim, in August used GLM 5.2 for a “security review,” according to a LinkedIn post.

The company is also a major Democratic political vendor and received tens of millions of dollars in tax breaks from California Democratic Gov. Gavin Newsom and New York Democratic Gov. Kathy Hochul, according to the Washington Free Beacon. ActBlue and the Democratic National Committee (DNC) processed $23.3 million in payroll expenses through the payroll platform during the 2026 midterm cycle, per the outlet.

The startup has been busy on the lobbying front, hiring the Washington, D.C., firm Ballard Partners to advocate for data governance and payroll tax compliance, per disclosure forms.

Some of Rippling’s customers operate in highly sensitive American military, national security, intelligence and aerospace sectors.

Askari Defense, a Rippling customer, is a defense startup building anti-drone interceptors, according to the company’s website. The U.S. Army’s xTech|Adaptiv Strike competition selected Askari as a semifinalist in May, and it is heading to the National Training Center to put its Rift Alpha interceptor drone through more testing, per Defence Blog. The company didn’t respond to a request for comment.

The Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS), a sub-agency of the Commerce Department, added Zhipu to its Entity List in January, citing Zhipu’s efforts to aid China’s military modernization push. The BIS Entity List subjects foreign companies to certain export controls, according to the Cybersecurity & Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA).

This means that companies remain free to download open Chinese models as long as they do not send information onto Zhipu’s platform that would violate the sanctions, such as proprietary AI training code and software to develop advanced microchips, per the BIS.

In late September, Z.ai made its ZCode coding assistant publicly available after user data was uploaded to the Alibaba cloud. ZCode runs on the latest GLM-5.3 AI model, and disabled features while promising more transparency, Reuters reported.

“We welcome developers to continue reviewing ZCode and reporting potential issues,” the Chinese AI lab told the outlet in September.

Chinese cybersecurity firm NSFOCUS found that the users’ code data was deleted, Zhipu claimed, according to Reuters. NSFOCUS and the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology, a state-run research institute, founded a joint laboratory in 2022 to boost data security, according to a report from Chinese state-backed China Daily.

A BIS spokesperson referred the DCNF to its 2025 annual report detailing how the Biden administration granted over 2,100 licenses for companies on its Entity List, while BIS only provided 16 licenses to companies on the Entity List between the second quarter and fourth quarter of 2025.

Texas Republican Gov. Greg Abbott added Zhipu to Texas’s Prohibited Technologies List for state employees and government devices in January.

“Rogue actors across the globe who wish harm on Texans should not be allowed to infiltrate our state’s network and devices,” Abbott said in a statement at the time. “Hostile adversaries harvest user data through AI and other applications and hardware to exploit, manipulate, and violate users and put them at extreme risk.”

Chinese AI models have grown from a relatively small share to a majority on two major AI developer platforms, CNBC reported in late September. Their share accounted for 57-67% of tokens used on OpenRouter in the week of September 14, up from 6-13% in February, per the outlet. Developers on Vercel used these models heavily, driving their market share from 11% in January to 55% in August.

“Chinese models are becoming capable enough for more tasks at a much lower cost. Once a model meets the quality bar for the job, that price difference becomes compelling,” Harpreet Arora, head of agentic infrastructure at Vercel, told the outlet, adding that some companies prefer to use frontier American models for more complicated tasks.

China has closed the gap with America’s leading AI models as its top models barely trail U.S. on key benchmarks, according to Bloomberg Intelligence.

U.S. companies accounted for around 30% of the tokens consumed on Chinese AI models through OpenRouter since February, peaking at 46%, according to a CNBC report.

The threat of a Chinese AI model to a business depends on how one connects to the model, Kyle Chan, a fellow at the John L. Thorton China Center at the Brookings Institution, told the DCNF.

AI users face the most danger when connecting directly to the AI models through a subscription or an Application Programming Interface (API), he warned. An API serves as a digital messenger that allows two different software applications to talk to each other, according to Amazon Web Services (AWS).

“You’re literally sending your data, all your prompts, all that information, whatever you put into the model, you’re sending it essentially to China,” Chan said.

Many people use Chinese models indirectly through an AI developer platform such as OpenRouter or through an “abliterated” model, an AI model trained to refuse harmful or bad requests.

Chan said that these methods have “much less risk, but not zero [risk].” But most users don’t connect to Chinese AI models this way, Fedusiak cautioned.

There may be a second, potentially worse, risk of using Chinese AI, which Chan calls “supply chain poisoning.” He argues that AI models could be “poisoned” with bad documents that could lead to vulnerabilities or even contain “deliberately engineered backdoors,” as he explained in an April article for War on the Rocks.

Smaller companies such as startups may not want to drop a “whole bunch of money” on Claude or other frontier AI models, Chan said.

“The reported situation with Z.ai should serve as a reminder to firms looking to integrate AI into their operations to be mindful of the firms they’re partnering with. Businesses need to trust that when they partner with a firm, they will do what they claim they do when it comes to retention of uploading,” James Czerniawski, the head of emerging technology policy for the Consumer Choice Center, told the DCNF.

“Z.ai had a poor configuration that allowed for the incidents to occur to begin with,” Czerniawski added. “Given other concerns around IP theft from China and the fact there is no way to verify the files that were accidentally uploaded to Z.ai were deleted, this only serves as further reason to tread carefully when interacting with these types of companies.”

Anthropic has accused Chinese AI labs of mishandling users’ data.

The American AI lab said Zhipu used its Claude AI model to improve its own capabilities, according to the company’s September Threat Intelligence Report. The company said that Moonshot AI, the Chinese AI lab that produces the Kimi family of AI models, “silently forwarded customer requests to Claude, instead of processing them through Kimi.” (RELATED: China’s Hottest AI Company Accused Of Stealing Anthropic Data In ‘Covert’ Plot)

DeepSeek, another Chinese AI company, also allegedly used tactics similar to Moonshot’s, according to the Threat Intelligence Report.

“In software, until these kinds of attacks start taking place and become, you know, sensitized to developers, I think they’re going to continue choosing the cheapest option, and frankly, I find it difficult to blame them, especially if you’re a startup trying to conserve burn rate. Of course, you’re going to use the cheapest, most effective tools available to you. Yeah, but the risk is there. People shouldn’t be blind to it,” Fedusiak told the DCNF.

Disclosure: The Daily Caller News Foundation is a Rippling customer.

استفاده یک استارت‌آپ منابع انسانی در سانفرانسیسکو از مدل آزمایشگاه هوش مصنوعی چینی در لیست سیاه، زنگ خطر را به صدا در می‌آورد، زیرا پکن همچنان در شرکت‌های آمریکایی فعال است. Rippling خود را به عنوان یک پلتفرم هوش مصنوعی یک مرحله‌ای برای منابع انسانی، فناوری اطلاعات و امور مالی معرفی می‌کند که به بیش از 20000 شرکت آمریکایی خدمات ارائه می‌کند. سازنده مدل، Z. ai، که با نام ژیپو نیز شناخته می‌شود، ماه‌ها قبل به دلیل ارتباطش با ارتش چین در فهرست نهادهای دولتی ایالات متحده قرار گرفته بود. «هر داده‌ای که یک API را از طریق سرورهای مستقر در چین منتقل می‌کند، در معرض خطر استخراج عمدی داده‌ها و جمع‌آوری اطلاعات است. این همان مشکلی است که ما با TikTok داشتیم، اما مقیاس آن تا 100 برابر بدتر شدن اطلاعات شخصی افراد است. رایان فدوسیاک، یکی از همکاران مؤسسه امریکن انترپرایز (AEI) که بر چین و مسائل مرتبط با هوش مصنوعی متمرکز است، به بنیاد Daily Caller News می‌گوید: «آن‌ها ویدیوهای سرگرم‌کننده‌ای از رقص بچه‌ها نمی‌سازند، اما در مورد همه جنبه‌های زندگی‌شان توصیه‌های حساس می‌خواهند، زیرا از سیستم‌های هوش مصنوعی استفاده می‌کنند.» هنوز اما من نگران هستم که پتانسیل مطمئناً وجود داشته باشد.» Rippling تنها شرکتی نیست که هوش مصنوعی چینی را برای آزمایش درایو انتخاب می کند. غول هایی مانند DoorDash و استارت آپ های کوچک به طور فزاینده ای از مدل های هوش مصنوعی چینی استفاده می کنند زیرا آنها ارائه می کنند.
